description: This file defines the class `BinomialDistribution`, which implements the binomial probability distribution, including methods for calculating probability, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and distribution parameters.

classes.name: BinomialDistribution
classes.description: Implements the binomial distribution, providing methods for probability calculations, parameter accessors, and distribution support bounds.

methods.name: getNumberOfTrials
methods.description: Returns the total number of trials in the binomial distribution.

methods.name: getProbabilityOfSuccess
methods.description: Returns the probability of success in each trial.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability of observing exactly x successes.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability of observing exactly x successes.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the probability of observing up to x successes.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, calculated as n * p.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, calculated as n * p * (1 - p).

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the inclusive lower bound of the support, which is 0 unless p=1, then it's equal to the number of trials.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the inclusive upper bound of the support, which is the number of trials unless p=0, then it's 0.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is continuous (connected).
